statistics.materialUnavailable: Your material could not be loaded.
statistics.accountNotes: Activity uses study days that start at 04:00 in your time zone and covers all training in this language: words, idioms and sentences. New exercises count cards introduced that day; reviews count later graded answers, including repeats of the same card. Daily average includes inactive days; streaks allow today to remain unfinished; records cover the displayed year. Study time is active time on training cards and is available only since measurement started. Material shows word cards from enabled dictionaries you can read: coverage counts each meaning once, due counts each practised direction.
statistics.activeTimeHint: Active time on training cards. History, settings and background time are excluded.
statistics.measuredSince: Measured since {date}. Earlier time is not available.
statistics.yearHeatmap: Daily study activity over the past year
statistics.monthHeatmap: Daily study activity for three months
statistics.selectDay: Select a square to explore that day.
statistics.materialHint: Choose material to see its review queue and progress.
statistics.coverageHint: Learning progress follows the card across training setups. Started does not mean mastered; the total can change when the selected material changes.
statistics.notes: Activity uses study days. The heatmap shows an illustrative year ending 28 September 2026. Queue and coverage describe the current state. Activity counts completed exercises, including repeated attempts on the same card. Coverage counts unique cards. Daily average includes inactive days; streaks allow today to remain unfinished. Records refer to the displayed demo year. Study time is illustrative active practice time; real duration tracking is not connected. All numbers and saved scopes in this preview are illustrative, not your account history.

vocabularySelection.selectionHelp: Choose all entries or select a frequency range, from most to least common. Frequency selection includes only entries with available frequency data. Use Entry type below to limit the selection to words or phrases.
vocabularySelection.speechHelp: Spoken language uses conversations from CGN. Written language uses texts from SoNaR500. A word can be common in speech and less common in writing.
vocabularySelection.speechGeneralHelp: Choose a frequency list based on spoken or written language. The same word can occur at different rates in speech and writing.
vocabularySelection.rangeHelp: A lower number means a more common word. For example, 1–100 selects the hundred most common words. We show those found in your dictionary that match your other settings, so there may be fewer. Select the pencil to change the range.
meaningHelp: An entry can have more than one meaning. Each meaning can be studied separately.
Meanings follow dictionary order. Choose how many first meanings to include, or keep them all. If there are fewer, take those available. Each separate dictionary entry has its own limit.
In a new-only session, meanings already being learned are left out. If the first two are already being learned, they will not appear in that session. We do not replace them with the third.

tour.interfaceBody: Which language would you like for the app and this introduction? Choose another language or keep the current one.
tour.translationBody: Choose a translation language for meanings and examples. It can differ from the interface language. You can also turn translations off.
tour.secondaryMention: You can add a second translation language later in Settings → Languages.
tour.startBody: Start or resume training. If there are no cards, adjust training settings or open Library.
tour.revealBody: Select Show answer to turn the card over and see its definition and examples.
tour.exitBody: Your learning action is saved. Close the session to finish the introduction and choose further topics.
tour.libraryBody: Library lets you find words and choose the meanings you want to practise.
tour.meaningBody: This word can have several meanings. Choose the one you need: only that meaning is added to a collection.
tour.collectionsBody: Open Collections for this meaning. Collections group selected meanings; they do not copy or reset learning progress.
tour.membershipTitle: The meaning is in your collection
tour.membershipBody: The checked collection contains this meaning. Choose Done to continue; the meaning keeps its learning progress.
tour.goTrainingTitle: Make a training for the collection
tour.goTrainingBody: Return to Training. A collection selects material; a saved training also remembers how you practise it.
tour.createTrainingBody: Create a separate training for your collection. Your existing trainings remain available.
tour.sourceBody: Open Source to choose your collection instead of the whole dictionary.
tour.exercisesBody: Open Exercises. For this first collection training, keep Words and choose Direct.
tour.directionBody: Choose Direct. You see the word first and recall its meaning. Reverse starts with the meaning.
tour.saveTrainingBody: Save the training so you can return to the collection and these exercise settings.
tour.nameTrainingBody: Enter a recognisable name and save. This creates a separate saved training, not a new copy of learning progress.
tour.audioBody: Click the speaker to hear the word. Then explore its other meanings.
tour.detailsBody: This card shows one meaning. Click the three dots to open the dictionary entry with all available meanings.
tour.returnBody: Expand the meanings you want to read. Close this panel to return to the training card.
tour.knownTitle: If you already know the meaning
tour.knownBody: “Mark as known” is an alternative to “Learn” for a meaning you already know. It applies to this meaning, not every meaning of the word.
tour.reportBody: The flag button (Report) opens a problem report for translations, card content or application behaviour. Open it to explore the form.
tour.paused: Tour paused. Resume in Settings → Getting started.
tour.pauseIntro: You can pause the introduction and find it again in Settings → Getting started. After reloading, it resumes from the beginning of the current topic.
tour.collectionsTopic: Library, collection and your own training
tour.basicDoneBody: You have chosen your languages and tried a card. Explore more topics now, or return later in Settings → Getting started.
tour.statsViewBody: This panel shows learning directions, card presentations and reviews. Close it with the cross to continue.
tour.appearanceChoiceBody: This is where you change the application’s appearance. Choose light, dark or system theme.
tour.sharingTabBody: In Library, select the Collections tab.
tour.sharingMoreBody: Select the three dots to the right of your collection.
tour.sharingMenuBody: This opens sharing settings for the selected collection.
tour.sharingConfirmBody: Read the invitation link/code warning and confirm.
tour.sharingCopyLinkBody: Cards are shared through a collection. Select Copy link to send it to another person.
tour.sharingCopyCodeTitle: You can share a code too
tour.sharingCopyCodeBody: An invitation code is an alternative to a link. Select Copy code.
tour.sharingSentTitle: The invitation is ready to send
tour.sharingSentBody: Send the link or code however you prefer. The collection remains available until you close shared access. Close this panel.
tour.incomingSharedBody: Select the Shared tab in Library.
tour.incomingReceivedBody: This is where shared collections you have added appear. Select Added by me.
tour.incomingAddBody: Select Add by link / code to connect cards shared with you.
tour.incomingPreviewBody: Check the name and card samples. View only means the owner manages the collection while you can view and practise. Select Add to library.
tour.incomingAcceptedBody: The collection is now in your library. Click “View words” to open its cards.
tour.themeShortcutBody: This button on the main screens cycles through light, dark and system themes. Select it to try.
tour.themeShortcutDoneBody: Keep selecting it to explore all three modes. System theme follows your device. You do not need to open Appearance each time.
tour.wordBody: This is the current word or question. Try to recall its meaning before revealing the answer.
tour.answerBody: The back of the card shows the meaning and examples. Each meaning is learned separately.
tour.liveLearnBody: For a new card, click Learn. If you have studied it before, rate how well you recalled the answer. This updates your actual learning progress.
tour.liveOpenWordBody: The search is already prepared. Open a word and expand the meaning you want to study.
tour.liveMembershipBody: Select an existing collection, or create a named collection here. Wait until the meaning is added, then continue.
tour.liveSourceBody: Choose your collection as the training material. Then continue to configure the exercises.
tour.liveSharingCreateBody: Create a view-only invitation for this collection. Review the confirmation: people with the link or code can subscribe and forward it.
tour.liveInvitationBody: Paste a real invitation link or code you received, then check it. Adding a collection happens only after you confirm its preview.
tour.liveReportBody: This is the normal error report form. You can fill and submit a report if needed, or close it. Continue when you have finished looking.
tour.liveStatsBody: Click New or Learning above this meaning. Progress is tracked separately for each meaning and direction.
tour.topicDoneBody: You have finished this topic. You can return to the introduction and other topics in Settings → Getting started.
tour.waiting: This action is not available on the current screen yet. Finish the open dialog or wait for loading. You can pause and return from Settings → Getting started.
tour.storageError: Could not save your place on this device. The guide can continue, but may not resume after reloading.
tour.deviceHint: Your place in the guide is saved on this device. Closing tips keeps your collections and learning progress.
tour.returnTrainingBody: Return to Training using the highlighted navigation button.
